name: work-docs
description: Documentation and architecture diagrams. Tooling to lint Markdown and render Mermaid diagrams.

scripts.diagram: mkdir -p dist && mmdc --puppeteerConfigFile puppeteer-config.json -i Plan.md -o dist/Plan.md
scripts.diagram:png: mkdir -p dist && mmdc --puppeteerConfigFile puppeteer-config.json -i Plan.md -o dist/plan-diagram.png
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run diagram
